en.headline: Two trucks collide on San Tin Highway; driver trapped briefly
en.dek: A 5.5-tonne lorry hit the rear of a 10-tonne lorry near Fairview Park shortly after 11am, leaving one driver with a trapped foot and another passenger with abrasions.
body: Two goods vehicles collided on San Tin Highway near Fairview Park in Yuen Long at about 11.22am on Monday. A 5.5-tonne lorry travelling towards Yuen Long was suspected to have failed to stop in time and struck the rear of a 10-tonne lorry ahead.

The front of the trailing vehicle was severely damaged and briefly emitted smoke. Rescuers freed the driver, whose foot was trapped, and treated a passenger who suffered abrasions. Both were taken to hospital, one to Tuen Mun Hospital and the other to Pok Oi Hospital.
Part of the carriageway was closed after the crash, causing traffic congestion. Police said the cause of the accident was under investigation.

zh.headline: 新田公路兩貨車相撞 司機腳部被困一度救出
zh.dek: 上午11時22分近錦綉花園，一輛5.5噸貨車追撞前方10噸貨車，司機腳部被困，另一乘客擦傷，分別送院。
body: 周一上午約11時22分，元朗新田公路近錦綉花園發生兩貨車相撞。一輛5.5噸貨車沿往元朗方向行駛，懷疑收掣不及追撞前方一輛10噸貨車車尾。
尾隨貨車車頭嚴重損毀一度冒煙，司機腳部被困，救援人員到場將他救出；車上另一名乘客則擦傷。兩人分別被送往屯門醫院及博愛醫院治理。
現場部分行車線封閉，交通擠塞。警方正調查意外起因。
